64079-the-happy-hunting-grounds.title: Happy Hunting-Grounds
64079-the-happy-hunting-grounds.creator: Unknown
64079-the-happy-hunting-grounds.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Even as small children father held us responsible to the law of the jungle. He would take us out on camping trips to a neck of land four or five miles across the bay from home. We would row there in the afternoon, the boats laden with blankets and food. Then we would make a driftwood fire on which to fry our supper--usually bacon and chicken.

arxiv-2011-13363.title: Fields of locally compact quantum groups: continuity and pushouts
arxiv-2011-13363.creator: Alexandru Chirvasitu
arxiv-2011-13363.description: Abstract We prove that (a) discrete compact quantum groups (or more generally locally compact, under additional hypotheses) with coamenable dual are continuous fields over their central closed quantum subgroups, and (b) the same holds for free products of discrete quantum groups with coamenable dual amalgamated over a common central subgroup.

arxiv-2302-00698.title: Temperature gradient and asymmetric steady state correlations in dissipatively coupled cascaded optomechanical systems
arxiv-2302-00698.creator: Claudio Pellitteri 1 , G. Massimo Palma 1,2 and Salvatore Lorenzo 1
arxiv-2302-00698.description: Abstract The interaction between a light mode and a mechanical oscillator via radiation pressure in optomechanical systems is an excellent platform for a multitude of applications in quantum technologies. In this work we study the dynamics of a pair of optomechanical systems interacting dissipatively with a wave guide in a unidirectional way.

arxiv-2310-00866.title: Simpler Hamiltonian structure of Gravity in degenerate limit
arxiv-2310-00866.creator: Sandipan Sengupta
arxiv-2310-00866.description: Abstract We analyze Hamiltonian gravity in the limit of a vanishing (spatial) triad determinant. In the context of Barbero-Immirzi formulation, the Lorentzian constraints in this limit are found to exhibit a formal similarity to the Euclidean constraints of Ashtekar’s self-dual formulation, modulo the difference that the spatial diffeomorphisms become trivial.

arxiv-2502-16574.title: Regularized zero-inflated Bernoulli regression model
arxiv-2502-16574.creator: Mouhamed Ndoye, Aba Diop
arxiv-2502-16574.description: Abstract Logistic regression model is widely used in many studies to investigate the relationship between a binary response variable Y Y and a set of potential predictors X 1 , … , X p X_{1},\ldots,X_{p} (for example: Y = 1 Y=1 if the outcome occurred and Y = 0 Y=0 otherwise).

arxiv-2504-15317.title: Enhancing DR Classification with Swin Transformer and Shifted Window Attention
arxiv-2504-15317.creator: Meher Boulaabi, Takwa Ben Aïcha Gader, Afef Kacem Echi Zied Bouraoui
arxiv-2504-15317.description: Abstract Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of blindness worldwide, underscoring the importance of early detection for effective treatment. However, automated DR classification remains challenging due to variations in image quality, class imbalance, and pixel-level similarities that hinder model training.

arxiv-2505-19921.title: Calabi-Yau property in derived Koszul calculus
arxiv-2505-19921.creator: Roland Berger, Jun Maillard
arxiv-2505-19921.description: Abstract A Poincaré Van den Bergh duality theorem for strong Kc-Calabi-Yau algebras was obtained by R. Taillefer and the first author [ 4 , Theorem 5.11] under the assumption that the derived functors of functors involved in the statement exist.

arxiv-2602-02778.title: Probing The Dark Matter Halo of High-redshift Quasar from Wide-Field Clustering Analysis
arxiv-2602-02778.creator: Hao Meng (蒙皓), Huanian Zhang (张华年), Guangping Ye (叶广平)
arxiv-2602-02778.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hao Meng (蒙皓), Huanian Zhang (张华年), Guangping Ye (叶广平). High-redshift quasars have been an excellent tracer to study the astrophysics and cosmology at early Universe. Using 216,949 high-redshift quasar candidates ( 5.0 ≤ z < 6.3 5.0\leq z<6.3 ) selected via machine learning from the Legacy Survey Data Release 9 and the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer, we perform wide-field clustering analysis to investigate the large-scale environment of those high-redshift quasars.

pmc-10623171.title: Engineering neuroglobin nitrite reductase activity based on myoglobin models
pmc-10623171.creator: Mark D. Williams, Venkata Ragireddy, Matthew R. Dent, Jesús Tejero
pmc-10623171.description: Neuroglobin is a hemoprotein expressed in several nervous system cell lineages with yet unknown physiological functions. Neuroglobin presents a very similar structure to that of the related globins hemoglobin and myoglobin, but shows an hexacoordinate heme as compared to the pentacoordinated heme of myoglobin and hemoglobin.

pmc-11433465.title: Fermented Fish Collagen Attenuates Melanogenesis via Decreasing UV-Induced Oxidative Stress
pmc-11433465.creator: Kyung-A Byun, So Young Lee, Seyeon Oh, Sosorburam Batsukh, Jong-Won Jang, Bae-Jin Lee, Kyoung-min Rheu, Sichao Li, Min-Seok Jeong, Kuk Hui Son, Kyunghee Byun, Jose Luis Legido
pmc-11433465.description: Excessive melanogenesis leads to hyperpigmentation-related cosmetic problems. UV exposure increases oxidative stress, which promotes melanogenesis-related signal pathways such as the PKA, microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF), tyrosinase (TYR), tyrosinase-related protein-1 (TRP1), and tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP2) pathways. Glycine is a source of endogenous antioxidants, including glutathione.

pmc-11507977.description: In this study, we examined the effects of experimental intraperitoneal infection with haemotropic Mycoplasma ovis (0.5 mL of blood containing 80% parasitaemia) on selected serum biomarkers and cellular pathology in mice. After infection, M. ovis cells appeared in the blood films within one week.

pmc-12373881.title: A multistrategy improved hunger games search algorithm
pmc-12373881.creator: Qiu Yihui, Zhang Xinqiang, Li Ruoyu, Li Dongyi, Xia Feihan
pmc-12373881.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this paper, we propose a multistrategy improved Hunger Games Search (MHGS) algorithm to address several inherent limitations of the original HGS, including imbalanced exploration and exploitation, insufficient population diversity, and premature convergence.

pmc-12446387.title: Salmon nasal cartilage proteoglycan up-regulates Listeria monocytogenes-mediated immune response in mice
pmc-12446387.creator: Akio Nakane, Phawinee Subsomwong, Tatsuji Takahashi, Kenichi Ito, Krisana Asano
pmc-12446387.description: Highlights•Proteoglycan stimulates Listeria-induced cytokine responses in macrophages.•Proteoglycan treatment enhances host defense to Listeria infection in mice.•Listeria uptake is reduced in proteoglycan-treated macrophages.•Proteoglycan modulates various immunological molecules in mouse liver.Keywords: Proteoglycan, Listeria monocytogenes, Host defense, Cytokine, Macrophage, Proteomics Introduction Listeria monocytogenes is a facultative intracellular bacterium that is ordinarily non-pathogenic to healthy persons but that it causes opportunistic infections.

pmc-12785404.creator: Dobrochna Rabiej-Kozioł, Alicja Tymczewska, Aleksandra Szydłowska-Czerniak
pmc-12785404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cold-pressed rapeseed oil aligns well with the trend of growing demand for minimally processed, health-promoting food products. It is essential to identify suitable storage conditions that protect cold-pressed rapeseed oil from oxidation, thereby extending its shelf life. In this study, the effect of gelatin/polyvinyl alcohol film strips enriched with ethyl sinapate (GPE) and immersed in cold-pressed rapeseed oil samples was evaluated during an accelerated storage test (14 days at 40 ± 1 °C under light (power of luminous flux = 385 lm).

pmc-13262368.title: Nationwide survey of psychopathology and bullying in tic disorders with and without ADHD
pmc-13262368.creator: Yu-Ju Lin, Fang-Ju Tsai, Susan Shur-Fen Gau
pmc-13262368.description: BackgroundAttention deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and tic disorder (TD) often co-occur. Given the well-established strong link between bullying and adverse psychiatric outcomes, understanding how TD and comorbid ADHD jointly interact to influence bullying involvement is crucial for informing clinical assessment and intervention.

pmc-13334632.title: Enhanced Intracellular Stability and Translation Efficiency of mRNA Drugs by a 2‐arm mRNA Platform
pmc-13334632.creator: Xucong Teng, Jiahao Lin, Qiushuang Zhang, Xiangdong Zhang, Yicong Dai, Jinghong Li
pmc-13334632.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The poly(A) tail deadenylation and transient protein expression of messenger RNA (mRNA) extremely hinder its therapeutic potential in genetic diseases, from which it follows that improving RNA stability and translation efficiency has emerged as a critical priority. In this study, we construct a 2‐arm mRNA via a streamlined modular assembly approach, characterized by a unique topology formed through the dimerization of two mRNA 3’ poly(A) tails.

pmc-13575761.title: Individualized Stent for Tracheal Fistula Complicating Tracheostomy Following Esophagectomy
pmc-13575761.creator: Xiaerbate Zakeerjiang, Yu ChenYi, Liu Bing, Liu Bin, Liu YaTing, Yuan YiFei
pmc-13575761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Delayed‐onset tracheal fistula following esophagectomy with concurrent tracheostomy is rare and poses diagnostic challenges. A 79‐year‐old female patient with oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) developed a tracheal fistula following esophagectomy and tracheostomy. Repeated bronchoscopies via the tracheostoma failed to visualize the fistula orifice; the diagnosis was confirmed by computed tomography (CT) with oral contrast medium and complete tracheal inspection following temporary removal of the tracheostomy tube. A patient‐specific, fully covered self‐expandable metallic stent (FCSEMS) was implanted under endoscopic guidance.
